text: A radio signal takes about 1.28 seconds to travel one way between Earth and the Moon. The game’s multi-turn delay represents processing time.
On much of the Moon, daylight and darkness each last about two Earth weeks. The game’s day-five Energy change is a simplification.
A radiation shelter uses protective materials around the crew. Lunar soil can help shield astronauts.
A sol is one day on Mars, about 24 hours and 39 minutes. This game takes place on the Moon.
Absorbed radiation dose describes how much radiation energy a material receives per unit mass. Our storm levels are not actual doses.
